lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in roughly parallel vertical columns posterior to the gill slits following the body curvature.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with horizontal spot rows to create a coarse grid-like distribution of local maxima.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Horizontal linear feature on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with shadow-casting on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Densely packed distribution of high-luminance circular blobs on the dorsal surface of the visible pectoral fin.
